integration_architecture.canonical_integration_layer: InfrastructureDependency (INFRASTRUCTURE-005 §2) — the reference-only, downward-only dependsOn graph composing the nine certified concerns.

integration_rules.IINT-01: Composition is reuse-by-reference only; no concern is re-implemented (UIL-02).
integration_rules.IINT-02: Every dependency is a typed, identified ENG-005 reference (UIL-03/04/09).
integration_rules.IINT-03: Every dependency is downwardOnly=true; the dependsOn graph is acyclic (WF-3).
integration_rules.IINT-04: No duplicated ownership: each leaf meta-class is owned by exactly one concern.
integration_rules.IINT-06: Non-constitutive: mints no primitive/authority, selects no technology (UIL-15).

integration_architecture.service_boundary: additive infrastructure/** surface; composes engine/**, platform/**, data/**, service/**, application/** and Band-13 U01…U09 strictly by reference (UIL-02).
